notes: Recorded 83 programme rows for the doctorate level, which is every row of the 2027 English-taught doctoral catalogue (7 pages; faculties of Humanities, Social Science, Science, Engineering, Information, Agriculture/Life Science/Environment, and the International Campus ZJU-Edinburgh Institute). The catalogue does not state a total.

A programme offered by two schools (for example Microbiology, Developmental Biology, Food Science, Biophysics, Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Electronic Science and Technology) appears once per school, as the catalogue lists it.

The 'Other requirements' text (supervisor Form for Provisional Acceptance: must have / suggested / priority; contact details left out) appears in the catalogue in a merged cell next to the first programme of a school group; it is recorded on that first row and may apply to the following rows of the same school, as the layout suggests but does not state.
Catalogue year is 2027 (deadline 28 February 2027, Ocean Technology and Engineering 31 May 2027); the stored scholarship record is keyed to the 2026 cycle.
The Chinese-taught doctoral catalogue (separate PDF) is not included here because this list covers English-taught programmes only.
not_stated: A total number of programmes in the catalogue
Whether the supervisor-form rule of a merged cell covers every later row of the same school
